os_matrix.note: A second operating system cannot be measured on this machine; the CI matrix is the only place it can be run.

security.limit: AGSC-08-19: these lints prove neither safety nor the absence of novel injection. An implementation MUST NOT claim more.

perf.command: node bench/measure.js --layer perf   # sizes 100 500 501 1000 5000 10000, 3 runs each, median

parity.note: Compared as values after a JSON round trip, which is what AGSC-09-16 claims at rc.6; never byte-identical across the browser boundary.

tokens.no_claude_count: Anthropic publishes no offline tokenizer; no Claude token count is reported, because it would be a guess.

a11y.ceiling: axe-core finds on average 57 % of WCAG issues automatically; zero violations is a floor, never a conformance claim.
